title: Splitting: fourth ₹9,500 transfer in two hours to a clean-looking mule
story: A scammer tells her to send ₹38,000 'in parts under ₹10,000 so the bank doesn't block it'. Three parts have gone to different accounts; this is the fourth.
why: Each part is only 2.4× her usual and the payee is unflagged, but four payments to four new accounts in two hours is a series. We may miss it if the series features don't push the journey family high enough.
